source.probe: advance-matched Liberation Sans derivative (tools/build-metric-fonts.py): hmtx = Kristen ITC cloud advances; corpus Word PDF 2026-11-08 paces the face at 0.49 em/char against the UA serif's 0.39, line box hhea 1.0278/0.332 (1.36)

note:
Kristen ITC is an M365 cloud face Word downloads and renders real; macOS and
Chromium never see it, and its script PANOSE sent the name to the serif
fallback (Times, 24% narrower per line, so a 48-page corpus document lost a
page). The single Regular cut is advance-matched from Liberation Sans
(KristenITCGO-Regular.ttf); the rangeless face carries the non-Latin fallback
under the cloud font's hhea box. Registered weight-normal only: Word
synthesizes bold without changing advances.
